questions.question: • Q1 What happens if the spin speed during photoresist coating is increased?

explanations.a: Higher spin speed generally reduces coating thickness.
explanations.b: Correct! Faster spinning produces a thinner photoresist layer.
explanations.c: Wafer melting does not occur during spin coating.
explanations.d: Spin coating does not directly affect UV generation.

questions.question: • Q2 Why is soft baking performed after photoresist coating?

answers.a: To remove solvents from the photoresist

explanations.a: Correct! Soft baking removes excess solvents and stabilizes the coating.
explanations.b: Oxide growth occurs during oxidation processes.
explanations.c: Wafer cutting is not related to baking.
explanations.d: Doping is a separate semiconductor process.

questions.question: • Q3 What is the final outcome of the photolithography process?

answers.b: Creation of patterned regions on the wafer

explanations.a: Silicon ingots are produced during crystal growth.
explanations.b: Correct! Photolithography creates precise circuit patterns on the wafer.
explanations.c: Oxide crystal growth is not the purpose of photolithography.
explanations.d: The entire wafer surface is not removed.
